meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行方式开发新功能并修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是开发时习惯先写测试、再让代码通过的工程师
copy.tagline_en: Build features and fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice red-green-refactor and want tests to drive your code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按「红→绿」循环开发:先写失败的测试,再写刚好能让它通过的最小实现,一次只做一个切片。动手写测试前,它会先和你确认这次要测哪些公开接缝。
howto.when: 当你要求用测试先行的方式开发功能或修 bug、提到 red-green-refactor,或需要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 加个新功能,先写失败测试
say.note: 它会先列出要测的接缝跟你确认

say.text: 这个 bug 我们用 red-green-refactor 修
say.note: 先写一条能复现问题的失败测试

say.text: 给这段逻辑补集成测试
say.note: 只在公开接缝上测,不碰内部实现

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works the red → green loop: write the failing test first, then just enough code to pass it, one vertical slice at a time. Before writing any test it confirms the seams under test with you.
howto.when_en: Use when you want features built or bugs fixed test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or need integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD to add a feature, failing test first
say_en.note: It confirms the seams with you first

say_en.text: Let's fix this bug red-green-refactor style
say_en.note: Starts with a failing test that reproduces it

say_en.text: Add integration tests for this logic
say_en.note: Tests only public seams, not internals
